#Libraries

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(rFIA)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(sf)
library(USAboundaries)
library(ggspatial)
library(scales)
library(biscale)
library(cowplot)  
library(ggalluvial)
```

#Data
```{r}
# Working directory - Update as needed
fia.dir <- "C:/Users/smenicke/OneDrive - University of Wyoming/2026/Wyo Resilience Project/Analysis/Wyo Forest Resilience"
# Reading in FIA DB
db <- readFIA(states = "WY", dir = fia.dir, nCores = 10)
```

#Boundaries and Grids

```{r}
# Wyoming Boundary
wy_bound <- us_states(states = "WY") %>%
  st_transform(5070)

# Year that defines what is "recent" for statewide estimates
recent_year <- 2015

# Size for hexes - maps
hex_km <- 20

# Blank grid of hexes bounded to wy_bound
hex_grid <- st_make_grid(
  wy_bound,
  cellsize = hex_km * 1000,
  square = FALSE
) %>%
  st_intersection(wy_bound)

# Adding information to hexes
wy_hex <- st_sf(
  hex_id = seq_len(length(hex_grid)),
  geometry = hex_grid
)
```

------- BLOCK 1: Current Forest Structure. Not looking at remeasured plots, just current estimates of any plot that meets a forested condition (N = 4638) ---------------------------------------------------------

# Figure 1 - Forest Type Map

## Forest Type Labels

```{r}
# Lookup table for Forest Type
ft_label_legend <- db$COND %>%
  select(FORTYPCD) %>%
  mutate(
    ft_label = case_when(
      FORTYPCD == "182" ~ "Rocky Mountain juniper",
      FORTYPCD == "184" ~ "Juniper woodland",
      FORTYPCD == "185" ~ "Pinyon/juniper woodland",
      FORTYPCD == "201" ~ "Douglas fir",
      FORTYPCD == "221" ~ "Ponderosa pine",
      FORTYPCD == "265" ~ "Engelmann spruce",
      FORTYPCD == "266" ~ "Engelmann spruce - Subalpine fir",
      FORTYPCD == "268" ~ "Subalpine fir",
      FORTYPCD == "269" ~ "Blue spruce",
      FORTYPCD == "281" ~ "Lodgepole pine",
      FORTYPCD == "366" ~ "Limber pine",
      FORTYPCD == "367" ~ "Whitebark pine",
      FORTYPCD == "509" ~ "Bur Oak",
      FORTYPCD == "517" ~ "Elm - Ash - Black locust",
      FORTYPCD == "520" ~ "Mixed upland hardwoods",
      FORTYPCD == "703" ~ "Cottonwood",
      FORTYPCD == "706" ~ "Hackberry - Elm - Green ash",
      FORTYPCD == "901" ~ "Aspen",
      FORTYPCD == "962" ~ "Other Hardwoods",
      FORTYPCD == "999" ~ "Nonstocked",
      TRUE              ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ft_label)) %>%
  distinct(FORTYPCD, ft_label)
```

## Creating Disturbance Lookup Table and Joining to QMD DF

```{r}
# Lookup table - If any condition in the plot has a disturbance code > 0 (no observed disturbance) restricted to Measured Years tied to a PLT_CN
disturbance_interval <- db$COND %>%
  filter(DSTRBCD1 > 0 | DSTRBCD2 > 0 | DSTRBCD3 > 0) %>%
  left_join(
    db$PLOT %>% select(CN, MEASYEAR),
    by = c("PLT_CN" = "CN")
  ) %>% 
  select(PLT_CN, MEASYEAR) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(disturbed = TRUE)
```

## FIA plots intersected with hex grid

```{r}
# Filtering database to recent sampling years - So periodic estimate plots aren't included
db_recent <- db

# Filter PLOT table
db_recent$PLOT <- db$PLOT %>%
  filter(MEASYEAR >= recent_year)

# Filter COND table 
db_recent$COND <- db$COND %>%
  filter(INVYR >= recent_year)

# Filter TREE table
db_recent$TREE <- db$TREE %>%
  filter(INVYR >= recent_year)
```


```{r}
# Intersecting cleaned db with blank hex grid
db_hex <- intersectFIA(db_recent, polys = wy_hex)
```

## Forest Area by Hex

```{r}
hex_ft <- rFIA::area(
  db_hex,
  grpBy = c(hex_id, FORTYPCD),
  landType = "forest",
  method = "TI",
  totals = TRUE
) %>%
  #mutate(FORTYPCD = as.character(FORTYPCD)) %>%
  left_join(ft_label_legend, by = "FORTYPCD") %>%
  mutate(ft_map = if_else(is.na(ft_label), "Other forest types", ft_label)) %>%
  group_by(hex_id, ft_map) %>%
  summarise(AREA_TOTAL = sum(AREA_TOTAL, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

## Dominant Forest Type by Hex

```{r}
# Establishing "dominant" forest type based on area
dom_all <- hex_ft %>%
  group_by(hex_id) %>%
  slice_max(AREA_TOTAL, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Joining to blank hex grid
map_dom_all <- wy_hex %>%
  left_join(dom_all, by = "hex_id")
```

## Plot

```{r}
# Color pallette
pal <- c(
  "Aspen"="#3D2A5A","Douglas fir"="#3B5BA5","Engelmann spruce"="#7AA6FF",
  "Engelmann spruce - Subalpine fir"="#5AC8E6","Juniper woodland"="#00A9A5",
  "Lodgepole pine"="#7FD34E","Ponderosa pine"="#F9B000","Rocky Mountain juniper"="#E67E22",
  "Subalpine fir"="#B24C9E","Whitebark pine"="#9B59B6","Blue Spruce"="#3F8FD2",
  "Mixed upland hardwoods"="#8C6C4F","Other forest types"="tan"
)

# Map
ggplot(map_dom_all) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = ft_map), color = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = st_boundary(wy_bound),
          color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4, fill = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, name = "Dominant forest type") +
  labs(
    title = "Dominant forest type across Wyoming",
    subtitle = "FIA plots (2015-2024) aggregated to 20 km hexagons"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

```

# Figure 1b - Share of Forest Area by Forest Type

```{r}
area_ft <- rFIA::area(
  db,
  grpBy   = "FORTYPCD"
)

area_ft_clean <- area_ft %>%
  filter(YEAR %in% c(2020, 2021, 2022, 2023)) %>%
  left_join(ft_label_legend, by = "FORTYPCD")

area_ft_filt <- area_ft_clean %>%
  group_by(ft_label) %>%
  summarize(ft_total = mean(AREA_TOTAL), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(ft_total)) %>%
  filter(!ft_label == "Nonstocked")

dom_ft_clipped <- area_ft_filt[1:10,]

forest_palette <- c(
  "Lodgepole pine" = "#4C9F70",                  # muted green
  "Engelmann spruce - Subalpine fir" = "#5B8DB8",# muted blue

  "Juniper woodland" = "#7A9A8B",                # sage
  "Rocky Mountain juniper" = "#9C8C6B",          # tan
  "Subalpine fir" = "#6E7FA3",                   # steel blue
  "Aspen" = "#D5B56E",                           # pale gold
  "Whitebark pine" = "#A4B7A3"                   # very muted green
)


dom_ft_clipped %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(ft_label, ft_total),
```

# Figure 2 - DBH and Basal Area Distributions

## Creating DF

```{r}
# Finding trees that were recently measured by plot (slice_max function), calculating Basal Area per plot, and joining to Plot Table
tree_struct <- db_recent$TREE %>%
  filter(STATUSCD == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    ba = pi * (DIA / 24)^2,
    ba_ac = ba * TPA_UNADJ
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    db$PLOT %>% select(CN, MEASYEAR, PLOT_STATUS_CD),
    by = c("PLT_CN" = "CN")
  ) %>%
  filter(PLOT_STATUS_CD == 1) %>%
  group_by(PLT_CN) %>%
  slice_max(MEASYEAR, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Double checking MEASYEAR range
quantile(tree_struct$MEASYEAR)

# Aggregating Median DBH and total plot Basal Area
plot_struct <- tree_struct %>%
  group_by(PLT_CN) %>%
  summarise(
    median_dbh = median(DIA, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_ba   = sum(ba_ac, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Plot

```{r}
# Median DBH of Recently Measured plots that meet at least one forested condition (n=4638)
p_dbh <- ggplot(plot_struct, aes(median_dbh)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#4C9F70", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Median DBH of forested FIA plots",
    x = "Median DBH (inches)",
    y = "Number of plots"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 30)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# Log-transformed basal area
p_ba <- ggplot(plot_struct, aes(log(total_ba))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#5B8DB8", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Basal area distribution of forested FIA plots",
    x = "Log-transformed basal area",
    y = "Number of plots"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# Combining panels
ggarrange(p_dbh, p_ba, ncol = 2, labels = c("A", "B"))
```

# Figure 3 - Dominant-Cohort Stand Age Map

## Dataframe

```{r}
# COND table - Forested plots that exhibited a condition proportion of greater than 0
# PLOT table - CN (Identifier), Measured Year (MEASYEAR), fuzzed LAT/LON
# "Recently Measured" - slice_max function
cond_age <- db$COND %>%
  filter(COND_STATUS_CD == 1, CONDPROP_UNADJ > 0) %>%
  inner_join(
    db$PLOT %>% select(CN, MEASYEAR, LAT, LON),
    by = c("PLT_CN" = "CN")
  ) %>%
  filter(MEASYEAR >= 2015) %>%
  group_by(PLT_CN) %>%
  slice_max(MEASYEAR, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(
    stdage_aw = sum(STDAGE * CONDPROP_UNADJ, na.rm = TRUE) /
                sum(CONDPROP_UNADJ, na.rm = TRUE),
    LAT = first(LAT),
    LON = first(LON),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Converting to SF Object

```{r}
# Converting to a spatial feature
age_sf <- st_as_sf(
  cond_age,
  coords = c("LON", "LAT"),
  crs = 4326
) %>%
  st_transform(5070)

# Joining to blank hex grid
age_hex <- st_join(wy_hex, age_sf, join = st_intersects)

# Aggregating to Median stand age
age_hex_summary <- age_hex %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(hex_id) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_age = median(stdage_aw, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Rejoining to hex object, clipping to Wyoming boundary
age_hex_map <- wy_hex %>%
  left_join(age_hex_summary, by = "hex_id") %>%
  st_intersection(wy_bound)
```

## Plot

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = age_hex_map, aes(fill = dominant_age), color = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = wy_bound, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Stand age (years)",
    option = "G",
    breaks = c(0, 100, 200, 300),
    limits = c(0, 300),
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Area-weighted Mean Stand Age across Wyoming",
    subtitle = "FIA plot means aggregated to 20 km hexagons"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

---------------- BLOCK 2: Structural Dynamics Through Time. Analyzing remeasured, forested plots that are tied to the same PLT_CN (Plot Identifier) with a stable link to the TREE table (N = 495). Reasons for this being the case: A stand-replacing disturbance took out all live trees and the subsequent regeneration does not meet the 1.4 inch DBH threshold for FIA measurement, trees in plot did not meet DBH requirement at t1. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Figure 4 - Distribution of QMD Change by Disturbance Occurrence

## DF For Forested, Remeasured Plots

```{r}
# The plot must be forested at BOTH the previous and current measurements.
forest_pltcns <- db$COND %>%
  filter(COND_STATUS_CD == 1) %>%
  left_join(
    db$PLOT %>% select(CN, MEASYEAR),
    by = c("PLT_CN" = "CN")
  ) %>%
  select(PLT_CN, MEASYEAR) %>%
  distinct()

# Lookup table for MEASYEAR_prev
prev_year_lookup <- db$PLOT %>%
  select(CN, MEASYEAR) %>%
  rename(PREV_PLT_CN = CN, MEASYEAR_prev = MEASYEAR)

# Canonical Interval - Plot CN's that match through time and were measured (PLOT_STATUS_CD == 1)
wy_forest_visits <- db$PLOT %>%
  filter(PLOT_STATUS_CD == 1, !is.na(PREV_PLT_CN)) %>%
  semi_join(forest_pltcns, by = c("CN" = "PLT_CN", "MEASYEAR" = "MEASYEAR")) %>% #forested at t2
  left_join(prev_year_lookup, by = "PREV_PLT_CN") %>%
  semi_join(forest_pltcns, by = c("PREV_PLT_CN" = "PLT_CN", "MEASYEAR_prev" = "MEASYEAR")) %>% #forested at t1
  mutate(pltID = paste(UNITCD, STATECD, COUNTYCD, PLOT, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(
    PLT_CN = CN,
    PREV_PLT_CN,
    pltID,
    MEASYEAR,
    MEASYEAR_prev,
    LAT,
    LON
  )
```

There are 545 plots that were forested at t1 and t2 (at least one condition out of many is forested - PLOT_STATUS_CD == 1).

## Creating QMD DF

```{r}
# TREE table - QMD for live trees
qmd_plot <- db$TREE %>%
  filter(STATUSCD == 1) %>% # live trees only
  filter(!is.na(DIA)) %>% # filtering out information that would corrupt plot metrics
  left_join(
    db$PLOT %>% select(CN, MEASYEAR),
    by = c("PLT_CN" = "CN")
  ) %>%
  group_by(PLT_CN, MEASYEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    QMD = sqrt(mean(DIA^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Joining with revisited plot lookup table
wy_visits_qmd <- wy_forest_visits %>%
  left_join(
    qmd_plot %>% rename(QMD_t2 = QMD),
    by = c("PLT_CN" = "PLT_CN")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    qmd_plot %>% rename(QMD_t1 = QMD),
    by = c("PREV_PLT_CN" = "PLT_CN")
  )

# Establishing secure link to the tree table - If no 
qmd_df <- wy_visits_qmd %>%
  filter(!is.na(QMD_t1), !is.na(QMD_t2)) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_change = (QMD_t2 - QMD_t1) / QMD_t1 * 100,
    chg_cat = case_when(
      rel_change >= 10  ~ "Increase",
      rel_change <= -10 ~ "Decrease",
      TRUE              ~ "Persistent"
    ),
    chg_cat = factor(
      chg_cat,
      levels = c("Persistent", "Increase", "Decrease")
    )
  )
```

N = 495, which means 50 remeasured, forested plots at both t1 and t2 had: 0 live trees at either visit (t1 or t2, which is pulled from the TREE table to calculate QMD), or missing records in the TREE table for either timepoint.

## Joining Disturbance Lookup Table to Remeasured Plots

```{r}
# Joining disturbance lookup table to remeasured, forested plots with stable TREE table links (n=495)
qmd_df <- qmd_df %>%
  left_join(disturbance_interval, by = "PLT_CN") %>%
  mutate(disturbed = if_else(is.na(disturbed), FALSE, disturbed))

# Only disturbed plots (n=101)
qmd_only_disturb <- qmd_df %>%
  filter(disturbed)
```


## Plot

```{r}
ggplot(qmd_df, aes(x = rel_change)) +

  # histogram
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(density)),
    bins = 200,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "white"
  ) +

  # Smooth overlay
  geom_density(
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "black",
    adjust = 1.2
  ) +

  # zero reference
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # ±10% thresholds
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-10, 10),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#2166ac",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # persistence band
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -10, xmax = 10,
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "#2166ac",
    alpha = 0.05
  ) +

  # facet by disturbance
  facet_wrap(
    ~ disturbed,
    ncol = 1,
    labeller = as_labeller(
      c(
        "FALSE" = "No recorded disturbance (n = 394)",
        "TRUE"  = "Recorded disturbance (n = 101)"
      )
    )
  ) +

  # zoom without dropping data
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-50, 50)) +

  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Quadratic Mean Diameter (QMD) Change",
    x = "Relative change in QMD (%)",
    y = "Density of remeasured plots"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

# Figure 5 - Pre and Post-Disturbance QMD by Disturbance Type

## Creating DF

```{r}
# Classifying and Aggregating Disturbance Type (there can be multiple per condition) to each plot
cond_disturb_type <- qmd_only_disturb %>%
  left_join(
    db$COND %>% select(PLT_CN, DSTRBCD1),
    by = "PLT_CN"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disturb_type = case_when(
      DSTRBCD1 %in% c(30, 31, 32) ~ "Fire",
      DSTRBCD1 %in% c(10, 11, 12) ~ "Insects",
      DSTRBCD1 %in% c(20, 21, 22) ~ "Disease",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(PLT_CN) %>%
  summarise(
    disturb_type = first(disturb_type),
    DSTRBCD1 = first(DSTRBCD1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Joining to Remeasured, Forested plots that have a stable TREE table linkage
qmd_disturb_type <- qmd_only_disturb %>%
  left_join(cond_disturb_type, by = "PLT_CN")
```

## Plot

```{r}
ggplot(qmd_disturb_type,
       aes(x = QMD_t1, y = QMD_t2, color = chg_cat)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ disturb_type) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Persistent" = "grey60",
      "Increase"   = "#2166ac",
      "Decrease"   = "#b2182b"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Pre- and post-disturbance QMD by disturbance type",
    caption = "Structural outcome indicates a ± 10% change in QMD",
    x = "Pre-disturbance QMD",
    y = "Post-disturbance QMD",
    color = "Structural outcome"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

# Figure 6 - Live Biomass Change by Disturbance Type

## Creating Biomass DF 

```{r}
# T2 - Current Biomass
# TREE table - DRYBIO_AG = Aboveground biomass, joined to remeasured plot lookup table
# COND table - TPA_UNADJ = Trees Per acre, TREE -> PLOT linkage
          #  - CONDPROP_UNADJ = Condition Proportion per plot, COND -> PLOT stratification constant if entire plot is not forested
tree_t2 <- db$TREE %>%
  inner_join(
    wy_forest_visits %>% select(PLT_CN, pltID, MEASYEAR),
    by = "PLT_CN"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    db$COND %>% select(PLT_CN, CONDID, COND_STATUS_CD, CONDPROP_UNADJ),
    by = c("PLT_CN", "CONDID")
  ) %>%
  filter(COND_STATUS_CD == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    b_ag_t2 = DRYBIO_AG,
    w = TPA_UNADJ * CONDPROP_UNADJ
  )

# Lookup table for T1 - Previous biomass
t1_lookup <- db$TREE %>%
  transmute(
    CN,
    b_ag_t1 = DRYBIO_AG,
    STATUSCD_t1 = STATUSCD
  )

# Linking PREV_TRE_CN (previous TREE ID at T1) to Current TREE CN at T2 - TREE level observations
tree_t2x <- tree_t2 %>%
  left_join(t1_lookup, by = c("PREV_TRE_CN" = "CN"))

# Aggregating per plot (T2)
tree_t2_summary <- tree_t2x %>%
  group_by(pltID, PLT_CN, MEASYEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    B2_live_ag = sum(ifelse(STATUSCD == 1, b_ag_t2 * w, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
    B2_dead_ag = sum(ifelse(STATUSCD == 2, b_ag_t2 * w, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Aggregating per plot (T1)
tree_t1_summary <- tree_t2x %>%
  group_by(pltID, PLT_CN, MEASYEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    B1_live_ag = sum(ifelse(STATUSCD_t1 == 1, b_ag_t1 * w, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
    B1_dead_ag = sum(ifelse(STATUSCD_t1 == 2, b_ag_t1 * w, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# T1 + T2
pools_both <- wy_forest_visits %>%
  transmute(PLT_CN, PREV_PLT_CN, pltID, MEASYEAR, MEASYEAR_prev) %>%
  left_join(tree_t1_summary, by = c("pltID","PLT_CN","MEASYEAR")) %>%
  left_join(tree_t2_summary, by = c("pltID","PLT_CN","MEASYEAR")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(B1_live_ag, B1_dead_ag, B2_live_ag, B2_dead_ag),
                ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
```

## Flux Components

```{r}
# Mortality 
# Pseudo code: All trees that were alive at T1 (STATUSCD == 1) and are dead at T2 (STATUSCD == 2)
mortality_by_plot <- tree_t2x %>%
  filter(!is.na(PREV_TRE_CN), STATUSCD_t1 == 1, STATUSCD == 2) %>%
  group_by(pltID, PLT_CN, MEASYEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    Mort_in_ag = sum(b_ag_t1 * w, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Growth
# Pseudo code: Biomass that did not exist before (PREV_TRE_CN == NA) but now exists (STATUSCD == 1) subtracted by previously known biomass 
growth_by_plot <- tree_t2x %>%
  filter(!is.na(PREV_TRE_CN), STATUSCD == 1) %>%
  group_by(pltID, PLT_CN, MEASYEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    grow_in_ag = sum((b_ag_t2 - b_ag_t1) * w, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Ingrowth
# Pseudo code: Trees that did not exist before (PREV_TRE_CN == NA) but are now alive (STATUSCD == 1) 
ingrowth_by_plot <- tree_t2x %>%
  filter(is.na(PREV_TRE_CN), STATUSCD == 1) %>%
  group_by(pltID, PLT_CN, MEASYEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    ingrowth_in_ag = sum(b_ag_t2 * w, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Joining Fluxes to Pools Dataframe
pools_both <- pools_both %>%
  left_join(mortality_by_plot, by = c("pltID","PLT_CN","MEASYEAR")) %>%
  left_join(growth_by_plot, by = c("pltID","PLT_CN","MEASYEAR")) %>%
  left_join(ingrowth_by_plot, by = c("pltID","PLT_CN","MEASYEAR")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Mort_in_ag, grow_in_ag, ingrowth_in_ag),
                ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
```

## Live Biomass Change

```{r}
# Survivorship per remeasurement interval
pools_event <- pools_both %>%
  mutate(
    surviv_frac = B2_live_ag / B1_live_ag
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(surviv_frac),
    B1_live_ag > 0,
    surviv_frac <= 3     # visual trim only
  )

# Joining disturbance type to Pools/Fluxes Dataframe and Classifying Plot Disturbance Agent by Fire/Non-Fire
pools_event <- pools_event %>%
  left_join(
    qmd_disturb_type %>%
      select(PLT_CN, disturbed, disturb_type),
    by = "PLT_CN"
  ) %>%
  filter(disturbed) %>%
  mutate(
    disturbance_class = if_else(
      disturb_type == "Fire",
      "Wildfire",
      "Other disturbance"
    )
  )
```

# Figure 7 - Sankey Diagram by Disturbance Occurrence

## Sankey Diagram Function

Psuedo code: Time 1: Live and Dead biomass per plot
            Fluxes of existing growth, mortality, ingrowth
            Time 2: Changed Live and Dead biomass per plot

```{r}
plot_flux_sankey_alluvial_clean <- function(
  sankey_df,
  use_Mg        = TRUE,
  units_suffix  = "Mg/ac",

  # ---- label placement ----
  label_spread_frac = 0.05,
  label_min_frac    = 0.02,
  label_min_value   = 5,
  flow_label_bias_frac = -0.15,

  # ---- pool label styling/placement ----
  pool_top_margin_frac = 0.03,
  pool_bottom_margin_frac = 0.03,

  # ---- aesthetics ----
  show_legend       = TRUE,
  flow_width        = 0.05,
  flow_outline_size = 0.55,
  bar_alpha         = 0.98,
  bar_width         = 0.07,
  pool_label_size   = 4.6,
  flow_label_size   = 4.0,
  right_label_xshift = 0.07,

  palette_overrides = NULL
) {

  # ---- core ecological colors ----
  col_live <- "#2ca02c"
  col_dead <- "#c62828"

  col_growth_pool   <- "#bdbdbd"  # light gray
  col_recruit_pool  <- "#7f7f7f"  # darker gray

  lighten <- function(col, alpha = 0.55) scales::alpha(col, alpha)

  row <- sankey_df %>% dplyr::slice(1)

  conv <- if (use_Mg) 1/2204.62262 else 1
  fmt  <- if (use_Mg) scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1, big.mark = ",")
          else         scales::label_number(big.mark = ",")

  clamp0 <- function(x) pmax(as.numeric(x), 0)

  # ---- fluxes ----
  growth     <- clamp0(row$grow_in_ag)                  * conv
  ingrowth   <- clamp0(row$ingrowth_in_ag)              * conv
  mortality  <- clamp0(row$Mort_in_ag)                  * conv
  survivors  <- clamp0(row$B2_live_ag - row$Mort_in_ag) * conv
  dead_prev  <- clamp0(row$B1_dead_ag)                  * conv
  dead_curr  <- clamp0(row$B2_dead_ag)                  * conv

  dead_losses <- clamp0(dead_prev + mortality - dead_curr)
  dead_retain <- clamp0(min(dead_curr, dead_prev + mortality))

  live_prev <- clamp0(row$B1_live_ag) * conv
  live_curr <- clamp0(row$B2_live_ag) * conv

  # ---- flows table ----
  flows <- tibble::tibble(
    from  = c("Live (prev)", "Live (prev)", "Growth", "Ingrowth",
              "Dead (prev)", "Dead (prev)"),
    to    = c("Dead (curr)", "Live (curr)", "Live (curr)", "Live (curr)",
              "Dead (curr)", "Dead losses"),
    flux  = c("Mortality", "Survivors", "Growth", "Ingrowth",
              "Dead retention", "Dead losses"),
    value = c(mortality, survivors, growth, ingrowth,
              dead_retain, dead_losses)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(value > 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(flow_id = dplyr::row_number())

  flux_levels <- c(
    "Survivors","Growth","Ingrowth",
    "Mortality","Dead retention","Dead losses"
  )

  # ---- alpha as semantic mapping ----
  flux_alpha <- c(
    "Survivors"      = 0.60,
    "Growth"         = 0.50,
    "Ingrowth"       = 0.50,
    "Mortality"      = 0.70,
    "Dead retention" = 0.60,
    "Dead losses"    = 0.40
  )

  # ---- long format ----
  long <- flows %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(from, to), names_to = "side",
                        values_to = "stratum") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      x = factor(ifelse(side == "from", "Prev", "Curr"),
                 levels = c("Prev","Curr")),
      stratum = factor(
        stratum,
        levels = c("Live (prev)", "Dead (prev)",
                   "Growth", "Ingrowth",
                   "Live (curr)", "Dead (curr)", "Dead losses")
      ),
      flux = factor(flux, levels = flux_levels),
      order_idx = as.numeric(flux),

      pool_grp = dplyr::case_when(
        stratum %in% c("Live (prev)", "Live (curr)") ~ "Live",
        stratum %in% c("Dead (prev)", "Dead (curr)") ~ "Dead",
        stratum == "Growth"                          ~ "Structural growth",
        stratum == "Ingrowth"                        ~ "Recruitment",
        stratum == "Dead losses"                     ~ "Dead losses",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  # ---- pool totals for labels ----
  prev_total <- sum(live_prev, dead_prev)
  curr_total <- sum(live_curr, dead_curr)

  pool_vals_external <- tibble::tibble(
    stratum = c("Live (prev)","Dead (prev)",
                "Live (curr)","Dead (curr)"),
    x_num   = c(1 - 0.06, 1 - 0.06, 2 + 0.06, 2 + 0.06),
    y       = c(prev_total * (1 - pool_top_margin_frac),
                prev_total * pool_bottom_margin_frac,
                curr_total * (1 - pool_top_margin_frac),
                curr_total * pool_bottom_margin_frac),
    hjust   = c(1, 1, 0, 0),
    label   = c(
      paste0(fmt(live_prev), " ", units_suffix),
      paste0(fmt(dead_prev), " ", units_suffix),
      paste0(fmt(live_curr), " ", units_suffix),
      paste0(fmt(dead_curr), " ", units_suffix)
    )
  )

  # ---- flow labels ----
  total_in_curr <- sum(flows$value)
  lbl_thresh <- max(label_min_frac * total_in_curr, label_min_value)

  labels_df <- flows %>%
    dplyr::filter(value >= lbl_thresh) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(to) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cum = cumsum(value),
      y_lab = cum - value / 2
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(label = paste0(flux, ": ", fmt(value)))

  # ---- palettes ----
  pal_flows <- c(
  "Survivors"      = scales::alpha(col_live, 0.30),
  "Growth"         = scales::alpha(col_live, 1),
  "Ingrowth"       = scales::alpha(col_live, 0.75),
  "Mortality"      = scales::alpha(col_dead, 1),
  "Dead retention" = scales::alpha(col_dead, 0.35),
  "Dead losses"    = scales::alpha("#cfcfcf", 0.80)
)


  if (!is.null(palette_overrides)) {
    pal_flows[names(palette_overrides)] <- palette_overrides
  }

  pal_pools <- c(
    "Live"              = col_live,
    "Dead"              = col_dead,
    "Structural growth" = col_growth_pool,
    "Recruitment"       = col_recruit_pool,
    "Dead losses"       = "#d9d9d9"
  )

  right_x_num <- 2 + right_label_xshift

  # ---- plot ----
  
p <- ggplot(
  long,
  aes(x = x, stratum = stratum, alluvium = flow_id,
      y = value, fill = flux, order = order_idx)
) +
  geom_alluvium(
    width = flow_width,
    colour = "white",
    size = flow_outline_size,
    curve_type = "cubic"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal_flows,
    name   = "Flux",
    guide  = guide_legend(ncol = 1, direction = "vertical")
  ) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_stratum(
    aes(fill = pool_grp),
    width = bar_width,
    colour = "grey30",
    alpha = bar_alpha
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pal_pools,
    name   = "Pool",
    guide  = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      nrow = 1,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1)
    )
  )

# ---- add pool labels conditionally ----
if (pool_label_size > 0) {
  p <- p +
    geom_text(
      data = pool_vals_external, inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(x = x_num, y = y, label = label, hjust = hjust),
      size = pool_label_size, fontface = "bold"
    )
}

# ---- add flow labels (size 0 is fine) ----
p <- p +
  geom_text(
    data = labels_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(x = right_x_num, y = y_lab, label = label),
    hjust = 0, size = flow_label_size
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title    = paste0("Biomass Flux Sankey — ", row$pltID),
    subtitle = paste0(
      row$MEASYEAR_prev, " → ", row$MEASYEAR,
      if (use_Mg) paste0(" (", units_suffix, ")") else ""
    ),
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.box.just = "center",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 120, b = 10, l = 70)
  )

return(p)

}
```

## Creating DF

```{r}
# Aggregate to two groups - disturbed and non-disturbed
pools_for_sankey <- pools_both %>%
  left_join(disturbance_interval, by = c("PLT_CN", "MEASYEAR")) %>%
  mutate(disturbed = if_else(is.na(disturbed), FALSE, disturbed)) %>%
  filter(!B1_live_ag == 0 & !B2_live_ag == 0) #Breaks biomass balance

# Define columns for Sankey diagram
sankey_cols <- c(
  "B1_live_ag","B1_dead_ag",
  "B2_live_ag","B2_dead_ag",
  "grow_in_ag","ingrowth_in_ag","Mort_in_ag"
)

# Non-Disturbed Plots
pools_nondist <- pools_for_sankey %>%
  filter(!disturbed) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(sankey_cols), sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_plots = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pltID = "All plots",
    MEASYEAR_prev = min(pools_for_sankey$MEASYEAR_prev),
    MEASYEAR      = max(pools_for_sankey$MEASYEAR)
  )

# Disturbed Plots
pools_dist <- pools_for_sankey %>%
  filter(disturbed) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(sankey_cols), sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_plots = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pltID = "All plots",
    MEASYEAR_prev = min(pools_for_sankey$MEASYEAR_prev),
    MEASYEAR      = max(pools_for_sankey$MEASYEAR)
  )
```

## Create Plot Panels

```{r}
# Non-Disturbed
p_nondist <- plot_flux_sankey_alluvial_clean(
  pools_nondist,
  show_legend       = TRUE,
  pool_label_size   = 2.25,

  pool_bottom_margin_frac = 0.22,

) +
  labs(title = "Non-disturbed plots (n = 394)") +

# Disturbed
p_dist <- plot_flux_sankey_alluvial_clean(
  pools_dist,

  pool_top_margin_frac    = 0,
  pool_bottom_margin_frac = 0.14,

  label_min_frac    = 1,
  label_min_value   = Inf,
  bar_width         = 0.10,
  flow_width        = 0.10
) +
  labs(title = "Disturbed plots (n = 101)") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.15, 0.15))) +
  theme(

  )
```

# Figure 8 - Sankey Diagrams by Disturbance Type

## Creating DF

```{r}
# Work at the plot–interval level (NOT one row per plot)
pools_disturbed <- pools_both %>%
  left_join(
    disturbance_interval %>% select(PLT_CN, MEASYEAR, disturbed),
    by = c("PLT_CN", "MEASYEAR")
  ) %>%
  filter(disturbed)

# Attach disturbance agent (same logic as QMD figures)
# N = 95, 6 plots are unidentifiable in their cause of disturbance
pools_disturbed <- pools_disturbed %>%
  left_join(
    qmd_disturb_type %>% select(PLT_CN, DSTRBCD1, disturb_type),
    by = "PLT_CN"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    disturb_type = case_when(
      is.na(disturb_type) ~ "Other",
      TRUE                ~ disturb_type
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DSTRBCD1))

# Ensure one row per biomass balance
pools_disturbed_unique <- pools_disturbed %>%
  distinct(
    PLT_CN,
    MEASYEAR_prev,
    MEASYEAR,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# Aggregate by Disturbance Type
pools_by_disturbance <- pools_disturbed_unique %>%
  group_by(disturb_type) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(sankey_cols), sum, na.rm = TRUE),
    MEASYEAR_prev = min(MEASYEAR_prev),
    MEASYEAR      = max(MEASYEAR),
    n_plots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pltID = paste0(disturb_type, " (n = ", n_plots, ")")
  )
```

## Build Plot Components

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 1) Build 4 panel plots (NO legend)
# -----------------------------
disturbance_sankeys <- pools_by_disturbance %>%
  split(.$disturb_type) %>%
  purrr::map(~ plot_flux_sankey_alluvial_clean(
    .x,
    use_Mg = TRUE,
    units_suffix = "Mg/ac",
    show_legend       = FALSE,  # panels: no legend
    pool_label_size   = 0,
    flow_label_size   = 0,
    label_min_frac    = 1,
    label_min_value   = Inf,
    pool_top_margin_frac    = 0.02,
    pool_bottom_margin_frac = 0.02,
    bar_width         = 0.12,
    flow_width        = 0.12,
    flow_outline_size = 0.6
  ))

wildfire_g <- disturbance_sankeys$Fire
insects_g  <- disturbance_sankeys$Insects
disease_g  <- disturbance_sankeys$Disease
other_g    <- disturbance_sankeys$Other

# Keep the spacing you like
strip_for_panel <- function(p) {
  p +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

wildfire_g <- strip_for_panel(wildfire_g)
insects_g  <- strip_for_panel(insects_g)
disease_g  <- strip_for_panel(disease_g)
other_g    <- strip_for_panel(other_g)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Create a legend donor plot (legend ON)
#    Force BOTH Pool and Flux legend entries to stack vertically
# -----------------------------
legend_g <- plot_flux_sankey_alluvial_clean(
  pools_by_disturbance,        # full data helps ensure all legend entries exist
  use_Mg = TRUE,
  units_suffix = "Mg/ac",
  show_legend       = TRUE,    # donor legend ON
  pool_label_size   = 0,
  flow_label_size   = 0,
  label_min_frac    = 1,
  label_min_value   = Inf,
  pool_top_margin_frac    = 0.02,
  pool_bottom_margin_frac = 0.02,
  bar_width         = 0.12,
  flow_width        = 0.12,
  flow_outline_size = 0.6
) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",

    # Stack legend blocks top-to-bottom
    legend.box       = "vertical",
    legend.box.just  = "left",

    # Force items inside each block to be vertical too
    legend.direction = "vertical",

    # Typography
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),

    # Keys + spacing (keeps it legible while using vertical space)
    legend.key.size   = unit(0.40, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.45, "cm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(0.40, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y  = unit(0.14, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x  = unit(0.10, "cm"),

    legend.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  ) +
  guides(
    # Aggressive override: whichever aesthetic Flux uses,
    # force its guide to be vertical & 1-column.
    fill   = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE, direction = "vertical", order = 1),
    colour = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE, direction = "vertical", order = 2),
    color  = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE, direction = "vertical", order = 2),
    alpha  = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE, direction = "vertical", order = 3),
    linetype = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE, direction = "vertical", order = 4),
    shape  = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE, direction = "vertical", order = 5)
  )

# Extract legend and wrap so it CLIPS and doesn't overlap panels
leg <- get_legend(legend_g)
leg <- as_ggplot(leg)

# -----------------------------
# 3) Panel labels
# -----------------------------
panel_labels <- pools_by_disturbance %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(disturb_type, " (n = ", n_plots, ")")) %>%
  select(disturb_type, label) %>%
  tibble::deframe()

# -----------------------------
# 4) Arrange panels (2x2) + legend column on the right
# -----------------------------
grid_panels <- ggarrange(
  wildfire_g, insects_g, disease_g, other_g,
  ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
  labels = c(
    paste0("A – ", panel_labels["Fire"]),
    paste0("B – ", panel_labels["Insects"]),
    paste0("C – ", panel_labels["Disease"]),
    paste0("D – ", panel_labels["Other"])
  ),
  font.label = list(size = 11, face = "bold"),
  label.x = 0.02,
  label.y = 1.01,
  align = "hv"
)

# Keep the spacing you like
fig_8 <- ggarrange(
  grid_panels, leg,
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(1, 0.32)
)

# -----------------------------
# 5) Add title and caption
# -----------------------------
fig_8_final <- annotate_figure(
  fig_8,
  top = text_grob(
    "Biomass Flux Pathways by Disturbance Type",
    #face = "bold",
    size = 14,
    vjust = 0.50
  ),
  bottom = text_grob(
    "Per-plot mean biomass fluxes (Mg/ac)",
    size = 9
  )
)

fig_8_final
```

# Figure 9 - Live Biomass Shifts by Forest Type

## Creating DF

```{r}
# Establishing condition requirements
cond_ft <- db$COND %>%
  filter(COND_STATUS_CD == 1, CONDPROP_UNADJ > 0) %>%
  select(PLT_CN, CONDPROP_UNADJ, FORTYPCD) %>%
  group_by(PLT_CN) %>%
  slice_max(CONDPROP_UNADJ, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Eligible Plots
eligible_plots <- pools_both %>%
  group_by(PLT_CN) %>%
  summarise(
    B1_total = sum(B1_live_ag, na.rm = TRUE),
    B2_total = sum(B2_live_ag, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(B1_total > 0 & B2_total > 0) %>%
  pull(PLT_CN)

# Aggregate by Plot
pools_sum <- pools_both %>%
  filter(PLT_CN %in% eligible_plots) %>%
  left_join(cond_ft, by = "PLT_CN") %>%
  group_by(FORTYPCD) %>%
  summarise(
    B1_live_ag = sum(B1_live_ag, na.rm = TRUE),
    B2_live_ag = sum(B2_live_ag, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_plots = n_distinct(PLT_CN),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(ft_label_legend, by = "FORTYPCD")

# Convert to share of live biomass
total_live_t1 <- sum(pools_sum$B1_live_ag, na.rm = TRUE)
total_live_t2 <- sum(pools_sum$B2_live_ag, na.rm = TRUE)

# Calculating proportions of total biomass
comp_statewide <- pools_sum %>%
  mutate(
    share_t1 = B1_live_ag / total_live_t1,
    share_t2 = B2_live_ag / total_live_t2
  ) %>%
  select(ft_label, share_t1, share_t2, n_plots)

# Convert to long-format for plotting
comp_long <- comp_statewide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(share_t1, share_t2),
    names_to = "time",
    values_to = "share"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time = recode(
      time,
      share_t1 = "Time 1",
      share_t2 = "Time 2"
    )
  )
```

## Plot

```{r}
ggplot(
  comp_long,
  aes(
    y = reorder(ft_label, share, FUN = mean),
    x = share,
    fill = time
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.65,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 0.001),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    breaks = c(0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Live biomass composition shifts by forest type",
    x = "Share of total live biomass (pseudo-log scale)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```
